messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Theta values in output file & diagnostic_file
parts:
Always on the unconstrained space (where the sampling happens, hence the
diagnostics).  Also be careful to note that the gradient will include any and all
Jacobians needed to map to the unconstrained space.

On May 5, 2014, at 9:59 PM, Rob J. Goedman <goe...@icloud.com> wrote:

Thanks Michael,

That works for theta. Is the gradient, in this case g_theta for the bernoulli rate gradient, always in the same unconstrained scale?

Bob, there are two issues here. Rob is talking about documenting
the diagnostic output, not the sampler parameters.

I’ll add something about n_divergent to the issue; documenting
the diagnostic input will take more work given that we’ll have
to discuss the map to the unconstrained space more carefully.
This should really be part of the full manual rewrite where we
discuss each step of Stan much more carefully.
